text:
alex: Heads up — after the canary pushed ~10:15 UTC our latency dashboard lost the p95/p99 lines for most models. The p50/p75 still show. Anyone else seeing this?

deploy-bot: Canary deploy finished: revision=infra/kanary-2025-03-17-1012, services: metrics-exporter v2.1.0 -> v2.2.0 :rocket:

maria: I can reproduce, p95/p99 are missing across the model routes. Grafana panel only shows median/avg. No errors in grafana UI.

jordan: tagging @maria @lee — can you dump the underlying PromQL or TSDB series for one of the model routes?

maria: Quick check: running on prometheus-head: 
```
seriesMatch: request_latency_seconds_bucket{job="model-serving", model="gpt-lite"}
```
returns empty. But `request_latency_seconds_count` and `_sum` exist.

lee: That smells like the exporter switched from histogram buckets to a summary. If buckets are gone you can't do histogram_quantile for p95/p99.

sam: I see an alert firing: `metrics-ingest-backlog` and `histogram-buckets-missing` from synthetic checks. support-bot posted: "Metrics pipeline: kafka lag spiked at 10:14 UTC"

alex: Repro steps I ran: hit /v1/generate on canary host x3 for 2000 requests, then looked at dashboard 10:20–10:25. No p95 line. Dashboard queries use `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))`.

maria: looking at exporter logs from canary: `2025-03-17T10:13:48Z exporter: transition metrics schema to client_v2; exporting summaries for request_latency_seconds`. So yes, the exporter now emits `_sum` and `_count` and `_obj` (summary) but not `_bucket`.

jordan: Oof. Did the release note mention proto change? I scanned the changelog, nothing obvious. Did ops enable any feature flag?

lee: The metrics client default changed to summaries for variable-bucket histograms in v2.2.0. We rely on buckets for p95/p99. Two short options: roll exporter back to v2.1.0 or have the metrics-bridge generate synthetic buckets (expensive). Rollback is fastest.

sam: kafka lag is clearing but many metrics already ingested without buckets. We need to backfill? Backfilling buckets from summaries is not straightforward. Better to stop the exporter change, redeploy, verify buckets return, then assess any data gaps.

alex: Can we do a canary rollback on the exporter component only? I want to avoid platform-wide rollback if possible.

jordan: I'll open a rollback PR and a follow-up to add an explicit flag in deploys to preserve histogram behavior. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/ops/merge/6789 (draft)

maria: I'll patch the dashboard to show a warning when `request_latency_seconds_bucket` series are missing so we don't stare at an incomplete panel. Quick Grafana panel note: add `count_series(request_latency_seconds_bucket{job="model-serving"}) == 0` as an annotation.

deploy-bot: Rollback in progress: reverting metrics-exporter to v2.1.0 on canary hosts -> start 10:42 UTC

lee: While rollback runs, if anyone needs to compute p95 from summaries you can use client-side quantile estimation on traces — but that's more effort and not accurate for whole fleet.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed: metrics-exporter v2.1.0 restored on canary at 10:49 UTC.

maria: Fresh check: `seriesMatch: request_latency_seconds_bucket{job="model-serving", model="gpt-lite"}` -> returns series again. Running dashboard query: 
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
```
now returns values for p95. p99 also present.

alex: Verified on dashboard — p95/p99 lines back for tested routes. Thanks all.

jordan: Follow-ups: 1) add change-detection tests in CI to ensure exporter schema changes are flagged; 2) add deploy note to breaks.md; 3) create a small job that alerts when key histogram metrics disappear for >5m. I'll assign those.

maria: I'll push the Grafana panel warning PR and open an incident summary in SRE docs with root cause and remediation steps.

sam: Filing a support escalation ticket summarizing customer-facing impact (some customers saw flatlines on percentile SLAs) and linking to rollback. Ticket #SR-4521.

alex: Great. Closing here once we have PRs linked. :thumbsup:

maria: PRs: grafana-annotation #412, exporter-rollback #413, deploy-flag #415. I'll add runbook notes.

support-bot: Alert cleared: `histogram-buckets-missing` resolved at 10:55 UTC.

lee: Postmortem next steps: decide if we want to preserve summaries support + synthetic buckets future work.

alex: OK — marking resolved for the immediate outage. Thanks everyone.
